jobs.title: Senior Director, GTM AI Product Leader
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Director to own the AI roadmap and strategy for our go-to-market organization: Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships. You will partner with our segments and RevOps to decide where AI creates the most value across the customer lifecycle, and work with Engineering to deliver it through a deliberate mix of best-in-class SaaS platforms (such as Salesforce, Gong) and custom-built solutions where off-the-shelf products fall short.

You will work with internal stakeholders to define the problems worth solving, prioritize ruthlessly, and measure adoption and business impact. You will be the accountable leader for how AI shows up in the way we sell, onboard, deliver, retain, and grow with customers and partners.

Key Responsibilities

GTM AI strategy and roadmap

Define and own a multi-year AI vision and a quarterly roadmap spanning Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships.
Identify, size, and prioritize AI use cases by revenue impact, productivity gain, cost to serve, and feasibility.
Establish clear principles for build vs. buy vs. configure, and make those calls transparently with business cases and total cost of ownership.
Align the GTM AI roadmap with company strategy, revenue targets, and the broader enterprise AI and data strategy.
Rationalize and govern overlapping tools and prevent AI sprawl across the GTM organization.
Run discovery, prototyping, pilots, and scale-up with clear success criteria and stage gates.

AI Across The GTM Functions

Sales: AI for prospecting and account research, lead and opportunity scoring, call and meeting intelligence, deal inspection and forecasting, proposal and RFP generation, pricing and quoting guidance, and rep coaching and ramp.
Customer Success: AI for health scoring and churn prediction, renewal and expansion signals, automated QBR and meeting prep, sentiment and call analysis, onboarding acceleration, and proactive risk alerts.
Professional Services: AI for scoping and estimation, project planning, knowledge retrieval, delivery acceleration, resource allocation, utilization, and margin improvement.
Partnerships: AI for partner identification and tiering, co-sell and pipeline insight, partner enablement, and ecosystem performance analytics.
Design cross-functional workflows that connect these motions, such as handoffs from sales to onboarding to delivery to renewal, so AI improves the whole customer lifecycle rather than isolated steps.

Adoption, change management, and value realization

Own adoption by partnering with Revenue Operations, enablement, and functional leaders on training, playbooks, and incentives so tools become part of daily work.
Define and report a KPI framework covering usage, productivity, pipeline and win rate, forecast accuracy, retention and expansion, services margin, and partner-sourced revenue.
Quantify ROI and report outcomes to executive leadership on a regular cadence.

Governance, data, and responsible AI

Work with Legal, Security, Privacy, and IT to set guardrails for AI use with customer and partner data, including access controls, data residency, model usage policies, and auditability.
Ensure AI outputs are trustworthy and that humans remain appropriately in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
Partner with Data and Analytics on data quality, definitions, and a shared source of truth.

Leadership and operating model

Build and lead a team of product managers and business analysts, and influence a broader matrixed group of Engineering, Data, and GTM Operations partners.
Establish intake, prioritization, and governance processes so GTM leaders (CRO, CCO, Services, Partnerships) jointly steer the roadmap.
Act as the executive-level voice on GTM AI, internally and externally, including with vendors, analysts, and peer companies.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in product management, GTM operations or strategy, sales or revenue technology, or related roles, with 5+ years leading teams.
Demonstrated success owning a technology roadmap that serves revenue-generating teams, ideally across more than one of Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships.
Deep working knowledge of the GTM technology stack, including Salesforce and conversation intelligence tools like Gong, and how data flows between systems.
Hands-on experience delivering AI/ML or generative AI solutions into production, including a practical understanding of LLMs, agents, retrieval, prompt and workflow design, evaluation, and cost management.
Strong build-vs-buy judgment, vendor management experience, and comfort building business cases.
Proven ability to drive change and adoption among frontline revenue teams and senior business leaders.
Excellent executive communication, with the ability to translate between technical teams and business stakeholders.
Analytical rigor and a bias toward measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience as a sales, customer success, or services practitioner or leader, or in a hybrid GTM + product role.
Experience with Salesforce platform capabilities (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce or equivalent AI features), data cloud or warehouse integrations, and Gong or similar conversation intelligence tools.
Experience in a B2B, enterprise, or professional-services-oriented environment with long sales cycles and complex account structures.
Familiarity with partner ecosystems, co-sell motions, and channel programs.
Experience establishing AI governance and responsible-AI practices.

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. For Ontario, Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $172,000 CAD - $222,000 CAD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

jobs.title: Senior Director, DevOps Product Management and Strategy
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

The Senior Director of DevOps Product Management and Strategy is a transformation-focused strategic leadership role that will shape RBC's future as a technology-led financial services leader. This position uniquely combines strategic vision, product management discipline, and organizational change leadership to drive the adoption of AI-enabled DevOps practices across our enterprise.

You will lead the multi-year transformation of how RBC develops and delivers technology, focusing on AI-integrated SDLC frameworks, harness engineering practices, and developer productivity optimization. This role requires both strategic thinking—setting 3-5 year vision and making critical technology investment decisions—and execution excellence, delivering innovative DevOps products and platforms that enable thousands of developers.

This is an opportunity to influence technology strategy at the highest levels while building and scaling proven approaches from pilot programs to enterprise-wide adoption, fundamentally changing how RBC builds software.

What will you do?

Strategic Leadership

Develop and own the 3-5 year DevOps transformation strategy aligned with enterprise technology and business objectives
Define the strategic vision for AI-enabled SDLC practices, determining which technologies, frameworks, and approaches RBC will standardize on, including harness engineering and specification-driven development
Lead strategic planning cycles including portfolio prioritization, investment allocation, and build-vs-buy decisions for DevOps capabilities
Conduct market intelligence and competitive analysis to position RBC as a technology leader and inform strategic technology choices
Partner with enterprise architecture and technology strategy teams to ensure DevOps strategy supports long-term business goals and enables business outcomes
Drive innovation strategy by establishing experimentation frameworks, pilot-to-scale pathways, and balancing innovation with operational excellence
Develop strategic partnerships with technology vendors, industry groups, and external advisors to accelerate capability development

Product Management & Execution

Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for DevOps platforms, tools, and services across the T&O organization
Lead cross-functional teams to deliver innovative DevOps products that enhance developer productivity and operational efficiency
Champion the integration of AI and automation technologies into DevOps and SDLC workflows to optimize processes and reduce manual effort
Collaborate with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and prioritize product features
Manage product lifecycle from conception through delivery, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer needs
Build and maintain relationships with internal customers, gathering feedback to continuously improve product offerings
Develop business cases and ROI models for DevOps investments, demonstrating value delivery to executive leadership

Leadership & Culture

Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the DevOps product organization
Stay current with DevOps industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to inform product strategy
Oversee budget and resource prioritization for DevOps product initiatives

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of product management or related leadership experience with 5+ years managing product teams and driving cross-functional initiatives
Proven experience leading enterprise transformation in complex organizations and developing multi-year technology strategies
Exceptional executive communication skills with ability to influence senior technology leaders and translate technical complexity into business value
Strong track record building strategic relationships with technology clients and presenting to executive audiences
Deep knowledge of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Understanding of AI/ML applications in DevOps and automation
Experience conducting market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and technology trend assessment
Strong business acumen with proven ability to build business cases, measure ROI, and make strategic decisions including portfolio rationalization and build-vs-buy analysis
Deep understanding of governance frameworks, security compliance, and risk management in regulated environments
Experience with agile product development methodologies
Ability to navigate complex organizational structures and influence without direct authority

Nice to Have

Master's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience with strategic planning frameworks (Wardley Mapping, OKRs, Technology Radar)
Management consulting background focused on technology strategy or transformation
Familiarity with AI development harnesses (Claude, Copilot, Windsurf) and harness engineering concepts
Experience with specification-driven development methodologies and scaling pilot programs to enterprise-wide adoption
Change management certification (Prosci, CCMP)
Product management (CSPO, CPM) or cloud platform certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Industry recognition as a thought leader in DevOps or platform engineering

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work

jobs.title: Director - Mobile Engineering, Wealth Technology
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 277642

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director – Mobile Engineering, Wealth Technology, is accountable for leading the engineering strategy, technical direction, delivery and ongoing evolution of mobile applications and engineering capabilities across Wealth Technology.

This is a senior technology leadership role requiring strong hands-on understanding of modern mobile engineering, combined with the ability to lead engineering teams and partner effectively with Product, Design, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other Technology teams. The Director will drive engineering excellence across iOS and Android platforms, establish scalable engineering practices, and ensure mobile applications are secure, resilient, performant and positioned to evolve with emerging technologies and customer expectations.

This role will be reporting to a Senior Director in Wealth Technology. Knowledge of the Wealth Management industry, digital financial services and emerging trends in mobile technology is an asset.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Own the Mobile Engineering strategy and technology roadmap across Wealth Technology, covering iOS and Android applications and supporting mobile engineering capabilities.
Lead the architecture and technical evolution of mobile applications, working closely with Architecture, Product and Engineering teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with enterprise technology standards.
Provide thought leadership on modern mobile technologies and engineering practices, evaluating new frameworks, SDKs, platform capabilities and development approaches against business needs and enterprise standards.
Establish and continuously improve mobile engineering standards and guardrails covering application architecture, reusable components, coding practices, performance, accessibility, testing, security and maintainability.
Drive the modernisation of mobile platforms, reducing technical debt and legacy dependencies while evolving applications towards contemporary native mobile architectures and engineering practices.
Build strong engineering capabilities across native iOS and Android development, including Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, while ensuring effective integration with APIs and backend-for-frontend (BFF) services.
Champion engineering excellence and developer productivity through automation, reusable capabilities, effective development tooling, code quality practices and continuous improvement.
Drive mature CI/CD and mobile release engineering practices, enabling reliable build, testing, security scanning and deployment processes across mobile applications.
Ensure security is embedded throughout the mobile software development lifecycle, working closely with Cybersecurity and Application Security teams to proactively identify and remediate vulnerabilities and manage technology currency.
Establish strong practices for mobile application reliability, performance and observability, using application and real-user telemetry to understand customer experience, application health and production performance.
Drive comprehensive quality engineering and test automation, including unit, integration, functional, accessibility, performance and regression testing, to improve release confidence and reduce production defects.
Own the technology aspects of mobile production health, including incident response, problem management, vulnerability remediation, resiliency, technology currency and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product, UX/Design, Digital and business stakeholders to translate customer and business objectives into sustainable mobile technology solutions.
Work closely with API, BFF, platform and other engineering teams to ensure clear technical contracts, scalable integration patterns and effective end-to-end engineering.
Lead, develop and mentor engineering leaders and engineers, building a strong mobile engineering community and ensuring appropriate technical depth, succession planning and skills development.
Establish meaningful engineering health measures, including application stability, performance, automated test coverage, security and vulnerability posture, technical debt, technology currency and engineering productivity.
Manage strategic technology partners and vendors where required, ensuring their engineering practices, deliverables and technology choices meet enterprise expectations.
Effectively communicate mobile engineering strategy, investment needs, technology risks, architectural decisions and delivery considerations to senior technology and business stakeholders.
Foster a culture of engineering ownership, innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement across mobile engineering teams.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience designing, developing and operating enterprise-scale mobile applications.
Strong technical knowledge of native iOS and Android development, including Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, and the mobile application development lifecycle.
Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams and engineering leaders in a large, complex technology organisation.
Strong knowledge of mobile application architecture and design patterns, modular application design, API integration and backend-for-frontend architectures.
Experience defining and implementing mobile engineering standards, reusable frameworks and technology roadmaps across multiple teams or applications.
Strong understanding of mobile security, including secure coding, authentication and authorisation, application security testing, vulnerability remediation and protection of customer information.
Experience with modern CI/CD, DevSecOps and automated testing practices for iOS and Android applications.
Experience with mobile application distribution and release processes across the Apple App Store and Google Play ecosystem.
Strong understanding of mobile observability and application performance management, including crash monitoring, performance telemetry and real-user monitoring.
Experience designing highly available and resilient digital applications and leading technology teams through production incidents and root-cause remediation.
Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and distributed systems, including integration between mobile applications, APIs, microservices and cloud platforms.
Experience managing technology currency, SDK/framework upgrades and mobile operating-system changes, with an understanding of their impact on application compatibility, security and customer experience.
Strong architectural judgement with the ability to balance customer experience, engineering quality, security, delivery speed, maintainability and cost.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex engineering topics into clear technology and business decisions.
Experience working in Agile product and engineering organisations with multidisciplinary teams spanning Product, Design, Architecture, Engineering, Quality Engineering and Cybersecurity.

Nice to have

Experience delivering digital solutions within Wealth Management, Brokerage, Banking or another highly regulated financial-services environment.
Experience operating large-scale consumer mobile applications with significant customer and transaction volumes.
Knowledge of GCP or another major cloud platform and its use in supporting modern digital/mobile architectures.
Experience with mobile experimentation, feature management, analytics and customer-experience telemetry.
Familiarity with emerging uses of AI-assisted software engineering and generative AI in the software-development lifecycle.

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.  
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance. 
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
Community Engagement - We offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Job Description

Director, Finance (CSM)

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. Establish strong practices for mobile application reliability, performance and observability, using application and real-user telemetry to understand customer experience, application health and production performance.
Drive comprehensive quality engineering and test automation, including unit, integration, functional, accessibility, performance and regression testing, to improve release confidence and reduce production defects.
Own the technology aspects of mobile production health, including incident response, problem management, vulnerability remediation, resiliency, technology currency and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product, UX/Design, Digital and business stakeholders to translate customer and business objectives into sustainable mobile technology solutions.
Work closely with API, BFF, platform and other engineering teams to ensure clear technical contracts, scalable integration patterns and effective end-to-end engineering.
Lead, develop and mentor engineering leaders and engineers, building a strong mobile engineering community and ensuring appropriate technical depth, succession planning and skills development.
Establish meaningful engineering health measures, including application stability, performance, automated test coverage, security and vulnerability posture, technical debt, technology currency and engineering productivity.
Manage strategic technology partners and vendors where required, ensuring their engineering practices, deliverables and technology choices meet enterprise expectations.
Effectively communicate mobile engineering strategy, investment needs, technology risks, architectural decisions and delivery considerations to senior technology and business stakeholders.
Foster a culture of engineering ownership, innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement across mobile engineering teams.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience designing, developing and operating enterprise-scale mobile applications.
Strong technical knowledge of native iOS and Android development, including Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, and the mobile application development lifecycle.
Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams and engineering leaders in a large, complex technology organisation.
Strong knowledge of mobile application architecture and design patterns, modular application design, API integration and backend-for-frontend architectures.
Experience defining and implementing mobile engineering standards, reusable frameworks and technology roadmaps across multiple teams or applications.
Strong understanding of mobile security, including secure coding, authentication and authorisation, application security testing, vulnerability remediation and protection of customer information.
Experience with modern CI/CD, DevSecOps and automated testing practices for iOS and Android applications.
Experience with mobile application distribution and release processes across the Apple App Store and Google Play ecosystem.
Strong understanding of mobile observability and application performance management, including crash monitoring, performance telemetry and real-user monitoring.
Experience designing highly available and resilient digital applications and leading technology teams through production incidents and root-cause remediation.
Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and distributed systems, including integration between mobile applications, APIs, microservices and cloud platforms.
Experience managing technology currency, SDK/framework upgrades and mobile operating-system changes, with an understanding of their impact on application compatibility, security and customer experience.
Strong architectural judgement with the ability to balance customer experience, engineering quality, security, delivery speed, maintainability and cost.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex engineering topics into clear technology and business decisions.
Experience working in Agile product and engineering organisations with multidisciplinary teams spanning Product, Design, Architecture, Engineering, Quality Engineering and Cybersecurity.

Nice to have

Experience delivering digital solutions within Wealth Management, Brokerage, Banking or another highly regulated financial-services environment.
Experience operating large-scale consumer mobile applications with significant customer and transaction volumes.
Knowledge of GCP or another major cloud platform and its use in supporting modern digital/mobile architectures.
Experience with mobile experimentation, feature management, analytics and customer-experience telemetry.
Familiarity with emerging uses of AI-assisted software engineering and generative AI in the software-development lifecycle.

Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.  
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.

Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.

Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.
